test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct to Indirect Speech.

She said, "My parents are visiting next week."

options.text: She said that her parents are visiting next week.
She said that her parents will visit next week.
She said that my parents were visiting the next week.
She said that her parents were visiting the following week.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** She said that her parents were visiting the following week.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"My parents are visiting next week" becomes "her parents were visiting the following week."**
 
 
• Pronoun "my" is changed to "her" to match indirect speech.
 
• Verb "are visiting" is changed to "were visiting" to reflect the past tense in indirect speech.
 
• "Next week" is replaced with "the following week" for proper indirect speech formatting.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is converted into a statement without quotation marks.
 
• Reported clause retains original meaning but adjusts for tense and pronoun changes.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *She said that her parents were visiting the following week.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "She said that her parents are visiting next week."

 
 
• Fails to change the tense appropriately for indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "She said that her parents will visit next week."
 
 
• Changes "are visiting" to "will visit," altering the original sentence's meaning.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "She said that my parents were visiting the next week."
 
 
• Incorrect pronoun "my" instead of "her."
